targets.title: Resolve every AIPAC PAC recipient in the 2025–2026 cycle
targets.analytic_constraint: A contribution establishes financial support, not control or vote causation.
targets.stop_condition: Every disbursement is reconciled to a recipient, candidate, race, amount, date, and amendment state.

targets.title: Resolve every United Democracy Project independent expenditure
targets.analytic_constraint: Independent expenditures are not direct payments to or spending by candidate committees.
targets.stop_condition: FEC aggregates reconcile to transaction-level records without double-counting amendments.

targets.title: Reconcile AIPAC-affiliated spending in the 2026 Michigan Senate primary
collect: campaign receipts distinct from outside spending
daily spending chronology and polling chronology
targets.analytic_constraint: Do not attribute all outside support for Stevens to AIPAC; preserve spender identity and legal separation.
targets.stop_condition: The reported approximately $30 million is reproduced or corrected from named committees and filings.

targets.title: Code AIPAC and UDP advertising against policy positions
targets.analytic_constraint: Message choice may indicate electoral strategy; it does not prove deception or unlawful coordination.
targets.stop_condition: Every located creative has a transcript, sponsor, race, spend, date range, and coded issue set.

targets.title: Resolve Palantir's Israeli Defense Ministry partnership
targets.analytic_constraint: Do not infer targeting-system use when Palantir denies a relationship to named IDF automated targeting programs.
targets.stop_condition: The legal instrument, value, scope, responsible offices, products, and performance period are source-backed or explicitly unresolved.

targets.title: Reconcile Palantir's U.S. government funding base
targets.analytic_constraint: Do not add ceilings, modifications, obligations, and recognized revenue as if they were equivalent measures.
targets.stop_condition: Every major award is reconciled to orders and obligations and then bounded against SEC segment revenue.

targets.title: Resolve Palantir PAC recipients and policy relevance
seed_entities: Employees of Palantir Technologies Inc. PAC
collect: defense, AI, surveillance, procurement, and Israel-policy activity
targets.analytic_constraint: Company-connected PAC support is not the same as a corporate contract or candidate control.
targets.stop_condition: The reported $81,500 in committee contributions is fully reconciled.

targets.title: Build the complete Palantir–WEF participation graph
collect: partner status by year and meeting
WEF centres, initiatives, councils, and reports
targets.analytic_constraint: Separate official WEF programming from privately hosted events occurring in Davos.
targets.stop_condition: Every located year and event is classified by official status, participants, subject, and source.

targets.title: Crosswalk Netanyahu's WEF participation with Israeli policy chronology
targets.analytic_constraint: Temporal proximity does not establish that WEF caused Israeli policy.
targets.stop_condition: Each appearance is mapped to its stated topic, participants, public meetings, and contemporaneous policy context.

targets.title: Search archived WEF records for settlement-network people and organizations
collect: Global Shapers and Young Global Leaders records
third-party event programs with official WEF identifiers
targets.analytic_constraint: Preserve no-result searches and do not turn name similarity into identity.
targets.stop_condition: Each seed has a logged query set, aliases, archives searched, and direct hit or explicit unresolved result.
